title: Beal Conjecture: Foundations v30.1.7 and v25.0.1 Forward Integration
description: Integration of the beal-level-26-foundations end-of-proof release v30.1.7-beal-final-43735b3 (10.5281/zenodo.22912430) and post-final v25.0.1-forward-43735b3 retrofit (10.5281/zenodo.22922473) into current beal-conjecture main. The integration preserves the corrected v31 honesty manuscript and the formal boundaries of both repositories. The forward interface orders MatveevBoundData, Level26SearchData, the proved B<1000 elimination, and the full B≤10^6 proposition retained as explicit proof data. The general Beal common-prime conclusion also remains explicit proof data; this release is not an unconditional proof of Beal's conjecture. The numerical surface records Delta=16A^8B^8(A^4+B^4)^2, v29(Delta)=26v29(B+3), 13|v29(Delta), 928/29=32, 32*29=928, |SL2(F13)|=2184, 48<2184, a29=-10, L/Omega=1/3 and 1/7, and Sel2_card=1. No numerical identity is used backwards to construct Matveev, Tate, Mazur, Ribet, modularity, exhaustive-search, or general Beal evidence. Lean v4.12.0; Mathlib 809c3fb3b5c8f5d7dace56e200b426187516535a. No lake update and no vendoring. Integrated release DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22923337; beal-conjecture concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22041831; foundations concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22379293.
